p: We noticed small positive changes - better engagement and improved attention during activities. Even small improvements felt like a big achievement to us. The app fits well with her ongoing therapies as it gives her extra practice at home, and it has helped us spend more structured and meaningful time together. I would say to other parents - be patient, because every child learns and improves differently. As a parent, I am always hopeful and learning along this journey with my daughter Nyra, and I am happy to support her growth in every possible way.
